title: Courtyard studio, Los Angeles
note: Fictional building. Light states are separate GLBs with identical geometry; see README.md.

states.label: Winter noon
states.caption: The winter sun is low, 32° above the horizon, so it passes under the canopy and through the glazed bay. A patch of direct sun reaches about 2.9 m into the room, onto the rug beside the review table.

states.label: Summer noon
states.caption: The summer sun is high, 79° above the horizon. The 1.6 m timber canopy shades the whole glazed bay, so no direct sun reaches the floor inside.

states.label: Late afternoon
states.detail: Autumn, 17:00 · low sun from the west
states.caption: An autumn afternoon at 17:00. The sun is low in the west: the timber fins throw long shadows across the courtyard paving and the light turns warm.

states.label: Evening
states.caption: After dark the room lights itself: pendants over the review table, track lights along the ceiling and garden lights in the courtyard. From outside, the glazed bay glows.

anchors.label: Review table
anchors.text: The review table, with the Cypress House model on it, sits just inside the glazed bay. This is where the winter sun patch lands.

anchors.label: Material library
anchors.text: Shelves of samples on the east wall, next to the east window.

anchors.label: Pin-up wall
anchors.text: A pin-up board on the west wall, beside the sofa.

anchors.label: Desks
anchors.text: Four desks stand along the north wall, away from the direct sun that comes through the south bay.

anchors.label: Entry
anchors.text: The entry door is on the west wall, reached by a path from the street.

anchors.label: Glazed courtyard bay
anchors.text: Six metres of glass facing south onto the courtyard, with timber fins outside.

anchors.label: Courtyard
anchors.text: A walled courtyard, 15.2 × 6.4 m, paved in concrete pavers, with an olive tree in a planter.

anchors.label: Timber canopy
anchors.text: The canopy projects 1.6 m over the bay. It blocks the high summer sun and lets the low winter sun pass underneath.

walk.title: Start outside
walk.text: A single room, 14 × 9 m, opens south onto a walled courtyard. The neighbouring blocks around it are schematic massing, there only to give the street a scale.

walk.title: The canopy in summer
walk.text: At summer noon the sun is 79° high. The 1.6 m canopy keeps the whole glazed bay in shade.

walk.title: The same bay in winter
walk.text: At winter noon the sun is only 32° high. It passes under the canopy and lays a patch of sun about 2.9 m into the room.

walk.title: Review table
walk.text: The review table sits where that winter sun lands, with the Cypress House model on it.

walk.title: Desks on the north side
walk.text: The desks line the north wall, away from direct sun through the bay.

walk.title: Material library
walk.text: Samples are kept on the east wall beside the east window.

walk.title: Pin-up wall
walk.text: The west wall carries the pin-up board, with the sofa in front of it.

walk.title: Courtyard, late afternoon
walk.text: At 17:00 in autumn the sun is low in the west and the fins draw long shadows across the paving.

walk.title: Evening
walk.text: With the lights on, the bay glows and the garden lights pick out the courtyard.
